parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence or documented police/border targeting, same-sex conduct legal, and a functioning kingdom court delivered marriage equality, extrapolated as tolerant, rule-of-law climate. That is offset by thin, dated trans-specific evidence: no documented acceptance of gender diversity (only LGB friendliness/centre), gender identity is not a named protected ground in the discrimination code, and facilities, border screening, documents and care are explicitly unassessed, not cleared. A 2013 permit obstruction of Pride is dated administrative friction. With no documented recurring visitor harm or universal exposure, this sits below the 0.65 documented-acceptance tier but above jurisdictions with proven harassment or unremedied exclusion.
